synthesis.trait: Shy, meek, deferential behavior around authority figures -- avoids drawing attention, eyes down, admits things only when directly compelled
Wary but willing to enter into a deal/wager for personal benefit (learning the secret pitch) when incentivized, mulling it over before agreeing

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Shy, meek, deferential behavior around authority figures -- avoids drawing attention, eyes down, admits things only when directly compelled
turning_points.what_changes: The kid who previously kept his eyes to the floor and answered only when forced now gives John a hard, defiant look and openly lies ('I dunno shit, mister') before walking off -- a concrete reversal of the earlier meek deference, revealing the meekness masked a shrewder, self-protective streak.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Wary but willing to enter into a deal/wager for personal benefit (learning the secret pitch) when incentivized, mulling it over before agreeing
turning_points.what_changes: Having gotten what he wanted (the pitch worked, Black Kid struck out, satisfying his side of the bargain's trigger condition), he refuses to honor his own agreed deal to tell John what he knows, directly reversing the wary-but-good-faith agreement he struck in scene19_beat1.
